Bound chain in the same run: degree, two-line bound, SAT certificates
Workflow: Parallel run (6 threads): solution chain and bound chain in one run, stopping when they meet; final solution found by: large neighborhood search

Best Objective Value: the shortest decomposition over the runs. Optimality Bound: the largest lower bound over the runs that holds for real weights. CPU Runtime: the measured CPU time of all threads in both rounds, mean over the runs with the seeds 1 to 4 (the CPU time of the run with seed 0 was not measured).
